title: jitso arsenal, with or without --all, never prints a value of ~/.claude.json or of .mcp.json, only names and key names
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.5 (names and key names only, never values)
intent: ~/.claude.json is seeded with token-like values in env, headers, an oauth block and a top-level key; the project's .mcp.json holds env values too.
